column1: # Slovak stemming judgements (versioned fixture; see NOTICE.md).
# Rows: family, lemma, part of speech, priority, expectation, form, grammatical features, source.
# expectation join: every form of the family must share one term. report: measured and printed, not asserted
# (P1 coverage that 4.0 may defer). Lines '!apart<TAB>A<TAB>B' assert that no form of family A shares a term
# with a form of family B. Source 'ud:N' is a form attested N times in UD Slovak-SNK r2.17 (c3dd2f1, all
# splits); 'paradigm' is the standard declension or conjugation table (slovensky.eu, Krátky slovník slovenského
# jazyka paradigms), not a native-speaker judgement. Words are lower-case NFC with diacritics.
